# DateRangePartition

- Namespace: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Planning.Partitioning`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`
- Kind: Class

## Summary

A single date range partition with non-overlapping boundaries.
Start is inclusive, End is exclusive: [Start, End).
